chemistry-killer-11.material:
Kwa $\mathrm{N_2O_4(g) \rightleftharpoons 2NO_2(g)}$, equilibrium constant mukusimba ndi $K = 0.4$ (mayuniti akasiiwa) pakupisa kunokosha. Pakupisa uku, $\mathrm{N_2O_4}$ ne $\mathrm{NO_2}$ zvinoiswa mumidziyo mitatu uye zvinosiiwa kwenguva refu.
(A) Vhoriyamu 2.0 L, $\mathrm{N_2O_4}$ 0.4 mol, $\mathrm{NO_2}$ 0.4 mol
(B) Vhoriyamu 0.5 L, $\mathrm{N_2O_4}$ 0.1 mol, $\mathrm{NO_2}$ 0.2 mol
(C) Vhoriyamu 2.0 L, $\mathrm{N_2O_4}$ 0.2 mol, $\mathrm{NO_2}$ 0.4 mol
Kana tichienzanisa reaction quotient $Q$ ne $K$, ndeipi sarudzo inopa nemazvo nzira ye net reaction mumudziyo wega wega panzira yekuenda kuequilibrium?

(C) Vhoriyamu 2.0 L, $\mathrm{N_2O_4}$ 0.2 mol, $\mathrm{NO_2}$ 0.4 mol

chemistry-killer-11.s.s1.explain:
Nhanho 1: Kusimba. (A) 2.0 L: [N2O4] = 0.4/2.0 = 0.2 M, [NO2] = 0.2 M. (B) 0.5 L: [N2O4] = 0.1/0.5 = 0.2 M, [NO2] = 0.2/0.5 = 0.4 M. (C) 2.0 L: [N2O4] = 0.1 M, [NO2] = 0.2 M.
Nhanho 2: Q. (A) Q = 0.2^2/0.2 = 0.2 < 0.4, forward. (B) Q = 0.4^2/0.2 = 0.8 > 0.4, reverse. (C) Q = 0.2^2/0.1 = 0.4 = K, paequilibrium.
Pindura: (A) forward, (B) reverse, (C) paequilibrium (c). (Sarudzo dzisiri dzakarurama: kushandisa mamole panzvimbo yekusimba kunopa Q = 0.4^2/0.4 = 0.4 ye (A) ne 0.2^2/0.1 = 0.4 ye (B), saka zvose zvinoita sezviri paequilibrium.)
